status: foundation API used by Windows read consumers; complete Windows product driver remains disabled

implementation.unsafe_policy: crate denies unsafe code; only the original synchronous minimal Win32 FFI module has a scoped allow
implementation.ffi_rationale: Rust 1.98.0 stable Windows metadata does not expose all required stable volume/file identities and ChangeTime; unstable std APIs are not enabled
implementation.ffi_ownership: borrows live std File handles; synchronous calls do not retain or close them; no raw handle escapes

admission.operating_system: Windows x86_64 only for handle API; pure path parser is host-independent
admission.volume: fixed local drive, NTFS only, all retained identities on the same volume

path.form: Unicode absolute ASCII drive letter, colon and backslash; backslash separators; final component is a file or explicit ReadDirectory target; volume-root-only paths reject
reject: control characters through U+001F and U+007F
DOS reserved stems, including extensions and spaces before a period
observed reparse components, including junctions, mountpoints and cloud placeholders
path.case_normalization: none; OS-resolved case aliases are admitted only through the same held identity checks
path.short_names: OS-resolved 8.3 aliases may be admitted for read leases; no guessing or name expansion is performed
path.output_protection: read identity admission is not lexical output-path containment or key-source protection; aliases require a separate output contract
path.long_paths: requires the actual process and Windows long-path policy; no verbatim-prefix fallback

admission.reparse_policy: reject every observed reparse attribute on held and named handles, with no fallback

hardlinks.Reject: final-file link count must be exactly one
hardlinks.Allow: explicitly admits additional names; final-file link count is still identity-bound

open.ancestor_order: retain volume root, then each intermediate directory, before opening the leaf

directory_access.reason: metadata-only handles do not participate in the required read-sharing checks

identity.repeated_query_checks: full snapshots: all projected FileInfo fields must agree across before/after; creation/write/attributes must also agree with FileBasicInfo
identity.ancestor_timestamp_policy: ignore unrelated sibling changes; directory size/link/timestamps are not lease identity equality fields
identity.leaf_comparison: all captured fields; no last-access comparison
identity.verification: recheck each retained handle and its exact named prefix, then retained and named leaf
identity.poison: an observed verification failure or mismatch permanently invalidates the lease; later verification returns platform_changed

directory_comparison.verify_unchanged: all captured final-directory fields; ancestors use same-object comparison
directory_comparison.verify_same_object: volume, file_index and attributes only for final directory and ancestors; explicit alternative permits sibling changes
directory_comparison.after_failed_full_check: permanent poison remains; object comparison cannot relax a previously observed failed full check

identity.object_query_checks: object-only acquisition: volume, file_index and attributes must agree across FileInfo before/after; attributes must agree with FileBasicInfo; both FileInfo samples must retain nonzero file_index and links
identity.object_query_scope: ancestor acquisition and held/named rechecks; explicit final-directory verify_same_object only; final file and directory open capture and verify_unchanged remain full snapshots

reads.read_all: complete bounded allocation with positional range read, EOF probe, and identity checks before successful return
reads.read_exact_at: checked offset plus length; complete bounded positional range with pre/post identity checks
reads.failure: discard any returned or caller-owned buffer bytes after failure; caller buffer may hold a prefix
reads.large_archives: file size may exceed a single-read limit; each admitted range remains bounded

limits.aggregate: multiple leases multiply the bound; caller owns aggregate handles and memory admission

diagnostics: static codes only; no path or OS error strings; no Debug for admitted path or lease

validation.contract_tests: source and contract consistency only; not execution of actual Windows calls
validation.host_independent: pure path tests may run on Linux
validation.wine: preliminary only; per-run external evidence required; corrected directory access is 0x81, and prior metadata-only sharing failure is not accepted evidence
validation.reparse_test: actual file/directory symlink test is ignored by default and requires separate privileged Windows execution

not_claimed: complete Windows product extraction and driver integration
DACL creation or private output directory policy
crash durability or directory-entry publication protocol
protection against privileged filesystem mutation, preexisting writable mappings, kernel attackers or DOS drive remapping

operator_path.operation: validate and own exact normal absolute drive path without filesystem I/O

directory.operation: retained ancestor and final-directory read lease; no enumeration, descendant opening or snapshot refresh
directory.enumeration: caller separately budgets enumeration handle, drops iterator before verification and directory lease before an independent file lease when enforcing one aggregate 65-handle ceiling

diagnostic_categories.platform_missing: opening failed with OS NotFound only
diagnostic_categories.platform_open: sharing, permission and other open failures
diagnostic_categories.platform_changed: any failed lease verification permanently poisons it
